newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Quaker downgrade outlined.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Quaker downgrade outlined.

text.p: -- Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette analyst William Leach said he downgraded Quaker Oats Co to underperform from market perform largely due to price.
-- On November 29, Quaker shares closed at 39-3/8, a new high. Shares at mid-day Monday were down 1-1/2 at 37-7/8.
-- The DLJ downgrade was reported earlier by market sources.
-- Quaker shares had risen on renewed rumors that the company might sell its Snapple beverage business. Quaker earlier declined to comment on the rumors.
